items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: The first piece I learned was that piece that my old boss used to play all the time. Lizzy on the Rails.

ctx.x: first taught them. Do you remember the names of any of them? Oh, I see. It's kind of mixed up there now. Do you remember the first piece you learned?
The first piece I learned was that piece that my old boss used to play all the time. Lizzy on the Rails. I don't remember the real name of it, but that's what they used to call it.
